atoms.1: Augmentin is not the same thing as amoxicillin.
atoms.3: Augmentin contains two active ingredients: amoxicillin and clavulanate potassium.
atoms.5: Amoxicillin works by stopping the growth of bacteria.
atoms.6: Clavulanate potassium is a beta-lactamase inhibitor.
atoms.7: Clavulanate potassium helps prevent certain bacteria from becoming resistant to amoxicillin.
atoms.9: Amoxicillin belongs to the penicillin class.
atoms.10: Amoxicillin is used to treat a variety of bacterial infections.

snippets.output: Augmentin is not the same thing as amoxicillin; Augmentin is a combination antibiotic containing two active ingredients: amoxicillin and clavulanate potassium.
Amoxicillin is a single penicillin-type antibiotic that belongs to the penicillin class, works by stopping the growth of bacteria, and is used to treat a variety of bacterial infections.
Clavulanate potassium is a beta-lactamase inhibitor that helps prevent certain bacteria from becoming resistant to amoxicillin.
